description: 402 conformance and security check for an x402 or MPP API: can buyer agents' SDKs pay it, and is it safe to pay? Checks the x402 v2 requirements (amounts, addresses, the token's EIP-712 domain, the same terms on every request), that malformed and forged payments are refused the same way, resource and pay-to binding, MPP challenges against the paymentauth.org draft, and the live price against the Bazaar and openapi.json. At 5 cents or less, one paid call also checks replay, mutation and no-store. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Failed calls aren't charged.
